verdict.rationale: Pendo's analytics page says it can "track and compare how users navigate your app to spot drop-off," which is a first-party claim about navigation analysis. Session replay lets a PM click a funnel drop-off and watch individual sessions, which adds per-user path visibility. Neither item explicitly describes aggregate path exploration anchored before or after a chosen key event. missing for 10: explicit path-analysis capability anchored on a key event (before/after), documentation of how paths are visualized or explored, independent or hands-on corroboration.
